_doc: Normalisation rules applied to BOTH expected (fixture) and actual JSON before diffing. Order: base-URL rewrite (actual only) -> ignore_paths -> patterns (in list order) -> unordered_lists -> diff. Path globs match paths like 'items[*].@id' ('*' matches anything incl. dots, brackets are literal, so items[*].x = any index). 'fixtures' is a glob on the fixture name. Copy this file and pass --rules to change behaviour.

patterns.name: uuid-hex32
patterns._doc: Plone UIDs (uuid4().hex), tus upload ids, scale hashes

patterns.name: image-scale-name
patterns._doc: patch_scale_uuid('uuid1') in the tests fixes scale names; real servers emit <field>-<w>-<hash>.<ext>

patterns.name: iso-datetime
patterns._doc: StaticTime (tests/statictime.py) pins created/modified to 1995-07-31; live servers do not. Not applied to event start/end or recurrence, which are content.

unordered_lists._doc: FTI behaviour lists are effectively sets
